snippet.title: Retro Cube Slider - Release Trailer [XB1 | XBX | MS Store]
snippet.description:
Microsoft Store: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/retro-cube-slider-windows/9n3ph33q2j2b
Xbox One: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/retro-cube-slider/9n3hc41x4lmf
Xbox Series X/S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/retro-cube-slider-xbox-series/9n3k1cbj2s83

Dozens of addictive single-screen puzzles packed with retro charm! Slide and outsmart wild neon contraptions in this stylish arcade throwback.

Anyone can play: just press a direction and watch the sleek neon cube glide across the board. Simple to pick up, tough to put down.
